reserves.name: Argentine-peso deposits at Argentine financial institutions

sources.label: Independent public accountant certification for wARS - March 2026

reserveReview.rationale: The March 31, 2026 certification reconciles 973,000,960.19 outstanding wARS across six chains and ARS 1,036,276,284 of collateral to Argentine bank and financial-institution statements, then certifies that all outstanding tokens are backed by Argentine-peso deposits. The engagement is expressly a certification rather than an audit or review, and the institutions and account terms are not disclosed.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Independent public accountant certification of wARS collateral as of March 31, 2026
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No reserve asset class is unclassified; the Argentine financial institutions, account types, provider allocations, and withdrawal liquidity are undisclosed.
